final_verdict.label: UNVERIFIED
final_verdict.summary: No matcher-proven earlier copy was found by memory lookup, reverse image search or text search. Insufficient corroboration — this does not show the event didn't happen (physical-world check). The claim could not be verified from the available evidence. Separately, the AI visual clues report 3 unverified observation(s) that clash with the claim (e.g. "No visible geographic, linguistic or event-specific cues linking the interior to Florida or to Hurricane Milton on 2024-10-09", frame ref [0, 6, 12, 18, 23, 29, 35, 41]); these are model observations, not independent evidence and not part of the visual-match proof.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
Insufficient corroboration — this does not show the event didn't happen.
